messages:
Rae: heads-up — during a quick onboarding run with the node sample I hit noisy DEBUG logs and mismatched request ids when a 401 triggered an auth retry.
Ken: can you paste a short log fragment?
Rae: ```
INFO  auth: token fetched
DEBUG http: id=req-aaa -> POST /v1/generate
WARN  http: 401 from /v1/generate
DEBUG http: id=req-bbb -> retry POST /v1/generate
```
Rae: also the user payload included inline code with a secret like `db_pass: `hunter2`` and it appeared unredacted in the DEBUG line after OTEL auto-init.
Maya: looking familiar. two issues: (1) retry path regenerates request id instead of keeping the original, (2) OTEL_AUTO_INIT is toggling log level and our redaction middleware runs too late.
Ken: for (1) we should prefer an existing request id when building the retry — if context.requestId exists, plumb it into headers (X-Request-Id) for each attempt. small change in retry-sender.
Maya: agreed. add unit test asserting the same X-Request-Id across attempts and that trace/span ids remain stable.
Rae: for (2) what if we add a logging.Handler/filter that redacts message.getMessage() before emission? acts as a last-resort even if middleware order is wrong.
Ken: yes — implement a sync LogFilter in SDKs that runs before emit and also make the redaction middleware register as early as possible.
Maya: plus change OTEL auto-init behavior: default OTEL_AUTO_INIT=0 for quickstart, or require REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_SAFE=1 to enable any auto-level changes. that prevents surprising DEBUG spam for new users.
Rae: i'll file a small repro in the sampleapp repo and link it in the PR.
ops-bot: created branch telemetry/fix-retry-reqid-and-redact-filter and started CI for sampleapp.
devx-bot: opened ticket DX-1301 "preserve request id on retry + redaction filter for otel-autoinit" and linked PR #520.
Ken: i'll draft the PR: reuse req id in retry-sender, add LogFilter to node & python sdks, and add unit+e2e with OTEL_AUTO_INIT=1 and a backtick-secret payload.
Maya: don't forget docs: quickstart note about OTEL_AUTO_INIT and a short troubleshooting FAQ entry. new users hit this during demos.
Rae: thanks — if we land this patch, we should cut a patch release and announce in #devex and #onboarding. saved a demo today. :slightly_smiling_face:
